en: In this course, we'll work with Deno, and
for that we'll need modern JavaScript and
we'll need some TypeScript.
Now, I do expect that you already do have
some JavaScript knowledge. You need
JavaScript basics for this course. You don't
need any TypeScript knowledge though. And in
this module, I'll give you a JavaScript and
TypeScript refresher.
We'll explore the most important modern
JavaScript features which you need to
understand to work with Deno.
And I will give you a brief introduction to
TypeScript
so that in this module in detail,
you will get all the JavaScript core
concepts you'll need and you'll have that
basic TypeScript knowledge which you need to
work with Deno.
Very important though, this module does not
replace basic JavaScript knowledge. You need
that before you explore this course and this
module.
It will replace basic TypeScript knowledge.
You don't need any prior TypeScript
knowledge. You can take my Understanding
TypeScript course thereafter though to dive
deeper.
You can also take my JavaScript course to
dive deeper, but you will need at least
basic JavaScript knowledge because in this
JavaScript refresher part, I'll only dive
into the more advanced, the more modern
JavaScript features which we'll also need in
this course.
